Text 1: eating breakfast helps students concentrate. Text 2: it depends on the breakfast. Sugary ones didn't help, while protein and whole grain ones helped most.

So the Text 2 researchers wouldn't call Text 1 wrong. They'd say it's missing something: only some kinds of breakfast help. That's choice B.
